request.reason: Preserve the existing bounded Text patch inspection guarantee for oversized Rust files while failing closed on candidate tokens needing unavailable full-source context; Raydot delegated technical correction.

changes.value: Rust .rs detection uses full after_text plus Git added-line/hunk provenance when full source is available. At least one added line in a candidate lexical/aggregate unit triggers inspection of all its old and new operands. Pair instruction and risky tokens within a decoded str/byte/raw literal, ordinary/doc/continuing nested comment unit, or bounded explicit concat!/static format! composition; do not pair unrelated literals solely because they share a file or hunk. For an existing oversized file represented as Text with a complete bounded patch but no after_text, preserve the inspectable clean result only when the patch contains no instruction or risky candidate token; a candidate whose semantic boundary or unchanged operand cannot be resolved is Unknown, while a complete directly inspectable strong pair remains a finding. This patch-only result does not claim the entire file is safe.

Regression evidence must include PR #1009 actual old-head RED-to-GREEN replay, same and cross-item explicit composition attacks, cross-hunk related and unrelated cases, an unchanged operand joined to a new marker, comments/raw/byte/escape cases, malformed evidence, Text bounded patch without full source both with and without candidate tokens, and TooLarge/Binary/Unavailable. Preserve the existing oversized-file bounded-safe-patch regression without adding Unknown solely because after_text is absent. Non-Rust path rules remain unchanged.

TooLarge, Binary, Unavailable, malformed evidence, and bounded Text patches with unresolved candidate context remain unknown or blocked rather than safe; a complete bounded Text patch with no instruction/risky candidate remains inspectable even if the oversized file's full text is unavailable.

Run cockpit-git and repository governance regressions for each content-state boundary and both bounded Text patch cases: no candidate preserves the existing inspectable result; candidate with missing semantic context is Unknown or a direct complete strong-pair finding.

Raydot delegated technical correction 2026-10-03: preserve the existing bounded Text patch no-candidate behavior; do not turn every oversized-file safe edit yellow solely because full after_text is unavailable. Candidate context ambiguity remains Unknown, and this does not change Binary/TooLarge/Unavailable semantics.

acceptanceCriteria: 旧 PR #1009 8d7f6fd4 的真实新增文件/单大 hunk 回放中，远隔且语义无关的 ignore previous instructions 与 tests/secret.rs 不被错误拼接成同一指令；不得通过删改或拆分对照字符串绕过检测。
同一可解释语义上下文中的跨行强制指令与危险操作仍触发 input_trust；分散 hunk 的相关攻击不能静默变为 green，必须保持不可信或明确 unknown。
TooLarge、Binary、Unavailable 或无法解析的变更证据保持 unknown/fail-closed，不把不可观察解释成安全；既有真实恶意输入正例保持通过。
Rust 仓库检测、Git 变更证据及其回归测试覆盖旧误报、真实攻击和边界负例；精确当前源码的 Runtime/Cargo canonical gate 与 PR CI 真实通过。
三语 input-trust 数据流文档说明新的证据配对边界、unknown 语义与保留的权限隔离；本 WI 不更改 PR #1009 的认知评估语义、Contract 或发布行为。

Rust .rs detection uses full after_text plus Git added-line/hunk provenance. At least one added line in a candidate lexical/aggregate unit triggers inspection of all its old and new operands. Pair instruction and risky tokens within a decoded str/byte/raw literal, ordinary/doc/continuing nested comment unit, or bounded explicit concat!/static format! composition; do not pair unrelated literals solely because they share a file or hunk.

Resolve simple immutable local literal bindings and directly parseable same-file zero-argument pure-literal-return functions when used in explicit composition. Detect string +, push_str, join, and complex/dynamic macros as composition evidence; if their value relation cannot be reliably resolved, emit Unknown rather than clean. Bound parsing, recursion, graph nodes, and expanded text; failures and limits remain Unknown. No claim of full-program dynamic taint analysis.

Regression evidence must include PR #1009 actual old-head RED-to-GREEN replay, same and cross-item explicit composition attacks, cross-hunk related and unrelated cases, an unchanged operand joined to a new marker, comments/raw/byte/escape cases, malformed or missing full source, and TooLarge/Binary/Unavailable. Non-Rust path rules remain unchanged.
